verdict.rationale: Spline ships an in-editor AI Agent, so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. The evidence only documents the opposite role: the Spline MCP Server, bundled in the desktop app, lets external clients like Claude, Cursor and Codex drive the Spline editor. Nothing shows Spline or its AI Agent connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not count toward this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
